title: Car Loan EMI
shortAnswer: Calculate monthly EMI for your car loan.
longAnswer: The Car Loan EMI Calculator computes the monthly instalment on a car loan from the principal, annual interest rate, and tenure. It uses the standard reducing-balance EMI formula: EMI = P × r × (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n − 1), where r is the monthly interest rate and n is the number of months. The result shows the EMI, the total interest paid over the tenure, and the total repayment. On the tax side, interest on a car loan is generally not deductible for a salaried individual—it is deductible only if the car is used for business and the loan is in the business's name. Depreciation on the vehicle may be claimed by a business instead. The calculator is a repayment tool, not a tax tool, so it does not compute any deduction. Enter the loan amount, rate, and tenure to see the EMI; use the amortisation to see how much of each instalment is interest versus principal. Confirm the rate and processing fee with your lender.
